question_en: C-118 welded in closed condition, DJ will trip through:
question_hi: अगर सी-118 बन्द अवस्था में वेल्ड हो जाए तो डीजे ट्रिप होगा:

options.C: EFDJ

explanation: DJ trips via EFDJ (Operation-1) if auxiliary starting contactor C-118 contacts weld closed.

question_en: If QVMT fails on run, Loco pilot will experience tripping in:
question_hi: अगर QVMT में खराबी आ जाए तब चालक को ट्रिपिंग महसूस होगी:

options.A: Operation - II
options.B: Operation - O
options.C: Operation - B
options.D: Operation - I

explanation: Traction motor blower airflow relay QVMT failure causes tripping in Operation-II when notches are taken.

question_en: WAG-9 Loco will shut down if battery voltage is reduced below:
question_hi: WAG-9 लोको शटडाउन हो जायेगा बैटरी वोल्टेज निम्न से कम होने पर:
explanation: Priority-2 warning appears at <92V, and automatic locomotive shutdown occurs if battery voltage drops below 82V.

question_en: Auto regression of GR on first notch without glowing of any pilot lamp is due to energisation of relay:
question_hi: बिना किसी लैम्प के एक नॉच में ऑटो रिग्रेशन किस रिले के इनरजाइज होने से होता है:

options.B: QD
options.C: QVCD

explanation: QVCD energises if vigilance acknowledgments are missed, initiating auto-regression of tap changer (GR).

question_en: OCR-78 is an:
question_hi: OCR-78 एक रिले है:

options.A: Over current relay
options.B: Over voltage relay
options.C: Earth fault relay
options.D: Differential relay

explanation: OCR-78 is an over current protection relay in the high-voltage 25 kV catenary circuit of 3-phase electric locomotives.

question_en: If GR is on notch while on run and Loco pilot experiences 'NO TENSION', GR comes to '0' through relay:
question_hi: अगर जीआर नॉच पर रहने की अवस्था में नो टेन्शन हो जाए तब जीआर स्वतः शून्य पर किस रिले के कारण आएगा:
explanation: De-energisation of relay Q-50 brings the GR (Graduator/Tap Changer) automatically to notch zero.

question_en: In 3-phase Loco BPCS will activate at speed above:
question_hi: 3-फेज लोको में BPCS क्रियाशील होता है निम्न गति से ऊपर:

options.A: 3 km/h
options.B: 10 km/h
options.C: 5 km/h
options.D: 15 km/h

explanation: Constant Speed Control (BPCS) can only be engaged and activated when train speed is above 5 km/h.

question_en: Push button switch to acknowledge fault message on 3-phase locomotive is:
question_hi: 3-फेज लोको में फॉल्ट संदेश की अभिस्वीकृति का पुश बटन स्विच है:

options.A: BPFA
options.B: BPCS
options.C: BPFL
options.D: LSFI

explanation: BPFA is the push button fault acknowledgment switch used by loco pilots on desk A.

question_en: Wheel slip protection differential relay is:
question_hi: व्हील स्लिप प्रोटेक्शन रिले है:

options.D: QD

explanation: QD relay senses the difference in traction motor currents during wheel slip and triggers sanders and regression.

question_en: The mechanical device connecting bogie to body in a 3-phase Loco is:
question_hi: 3-फेज लोको में बोगी से बॉडी को कनेक्ट करने वाला यांत्रिक डिवाइस है:

options.A: Traction Link
options.B: Primary suspension spring
options.C: Guide Rod
options.D: Compensating beam

explanation: The traction link transmits tractive and braking forces between bogie and locomotive body.

question_en: During RB operation if more than 1 kg/cm² pressure enters brake cylinder, RB cuts off through:
question_hi: आरबी के दौरान अगर 1 kg/cm² से अधिक प्रेशर ब्रेक सिलिंडर में प्रवेश करे तो RB कटता है:

options.A: SWC / PVEF
options.C: RGCP
options.D: RGLP

explanation: Pressure switch SWC (or PVEF interlock) cuts off Rheostatic/Dynamic Braking when independent/pneumatic brakes apply.

question_en: Energisation of QEMS causes:
question_hi: QEMS के इनरजाइज होने पर क्या समस्या उत्पन्न होगी:

options.A: Wheel slip indication
options.B: DJ trips / Panto lowers
options.C: Compressor stops only
options.D: Auto regression only

explanation: QEMS is the emergency stop relay; energising it causes emergency opening of DJ/VCB and lowering of pantograph.

question_en: Reset / Trip the MCB provided in HB-1/HB-2 only after:
question_hi: HB-1 एवं HB-2 में लगे MCB को रीसेट/ट्रिप किया जाना चाहिए निम्न के बाद:

options.A: Isolating battery switch only
options.B: Lowering panto & opening VCB
options.C: Applying A-9 only
options.D: Opening BL key only

explanation: High-voltage auxiliary cubicles (HB-1/2) MCBs must only be accessed and manipulated after VCB is opened and pantograph lowered.

question_en: Checking sign of ICDJ is:
question_hi: ICDJ का चेकिंग साइन क्या है:

options.A: DJ trips within 0.6 sec after releasing BLRDJ
options.B: DJ trips after 5 sec
options.C: DJ does not close at all
options.D: No tension on line

explanation: Initial Closing of DJ failure (ICDJ) occurs when DJ closes on holding BLRDJ but immediately trips within 0.6s upon release.

question_en: If QRS de-energises, Loco Pilot will experience:
question_hi: अगर QRS डी-इनरजाइज हो जाए तो चालक को क्या महसूस होगा:

options.A: DJ tripping only
options.B: Auto regression & emergency brake application
options.C: Cab light failure
options.D: Total loss of tractive effort only

explanation: QRS is the service/emergency application relay, dropping which causes rapid auto regression and brake application.

question_en: The checking sign of DJ Locking during No Tension is:
question_hi: नो टेंशन के दौरान डीजे लॉकिंग का चेकिंग साइन है:

options.A: DJ opens immediately
options.B: All pilot lamps glow
options.C: UA shows 0V while DJ remains closed
options.D: Panto lowers automatically

explanation: DJ locking occurs when MTDJ remains energized and DJ stays closed despite zero OHE line voltage (UA=0).

question_en: Main compressor MCB 47.1/1 is located in:
question_hi: मेन कम्प्रेशर का MCB 47.1/1 किस पैनल में स्थित है:

options.A: HB-2
options.B: SB-2
options.C: SB-1
options.D: HB-1

explanation: MCB 47.1/1 for Main Compressor 1 is situated in auxiliary circuit cubicle HB-1.

question_en: The normal position of switch 152 in WAG-9 Loco is:
question_hi: WAG-9 लोको में 152 स्विच की सामान्य स्थिति होती है:

options.A: 1 (NORM)
options.C: Auto

explanation: Rotary switch 152 (configuration/failure mode) is kept at position '1' (Normal) for standard driving operation.

question_en: Continuous current rating of WAG-7 Loco is:
question_hi: WAG-7 लोको की निरंतर करंट रेटिंग कितनी होती है:
explanation: WAG-7 continuous traction motor current rating is 900 A (its 10-minute short-time rating is 1250 A).

question_en: When an electrical relay is energised, its N/C interlock will:
question_hi: जब कोई रिले इनरजाइज होती है, तो उसका N/C इंटरलॉक सर्किट में:

options.A: Short-circuit
options.B: Close
options.C: Remain unchanged
options.D: Open

explanation: Normally Closed (N/C) contacts open when the relay coil is energized.

question_en: Loco Pilot gets TLTE on run, checking found LSB glowing; wedge Q-50 only after checking:
question_hi: ऑन रन में TLTE मिले और LSB जलती मिले, तो Q-50 को वेज करने से पहले जांचना चाहिए:

options.A: Compressors stopped
options.B: J1, J2, CTFs in motoring, L1-L6 closed
options.C: DJ in open condition
options.D: Reverser in neutral

explanation: Total Loss of Tractive Effort with LSB glowing means traction contactors/reversers must be physically verified before wedging Q50.

question_en: VCD should apply brake through which valve:
question_hi: VCD किस वाल्व के माध्यम से ब्रेक लगाता है:

options.A: SA-9 Valve
options.B: C3W Valve
options.C: A-9 Valve
options.D: IP Valve

explanation: VCD operates through the IP magnetic exhaust valve to rapidly exhaust BP pressure and apply emergency brakes.

question_en: When GR is stuck up in between notches DJ trips by the action of relay:
question_hi: यदि जीआर दो नॉचों के बीच में फंस जाए तो डीजे किस रिले द्वारा ट्रिप होगा:
explanation: In between notches, auxiliary interlock prevents de-energisation of Q44 within its timer, causing Q118/DJ tripping.

question_en: MCB 127.7 is located in which panel in 3-phase locos:
question_hi: 3-फेज लोको में MCB 127.7 किस पैनल में लगा है:

options.A: HB-1
options.B: Pneumatic Panel
options.C: SB-2
options.D: SB-1

explanation: MCB 127.7 (Control electronics traction / auxiliary circuits) is located inside control cubicle SB-2.

question_en: Parking brake cylinders provided in wheels of WAG-9 Loco:
question_hi: WAG-9 लोको में पार्किंग ब्रेक सिलिंडर किन चक्कों में उपलब्ध हैं:
explanation: Parking brake cylinders are installed on wheels 2, 6 (Bogie-1) and 7, 11 (Bogie-2) of Co-Co 3-phase locos.

question_en: QPH can be isolated by putting switch HQPH on:
question_hi: QPH को किस स्विच द्वारा आइसोलेट किया जा सकता है:
explanation: Switch HQPH is turned to '0' to isolate protection relay QPH (oil pump relay).

question_en: If TS switch is pressed in Loco provided with auto glowing flasher light:
question_hi: जिस इंजन में स्वतः फ्लैशर लाइट की व्यवस्था है, उसमें TS दबाने पर:

options.A: Buzzer stops
options.B: Flasher light switches ON manually
options.C: Headlight turns ON
options.D: Flasher light turns OFF

explanation: TS (Testing switch) or manual test switch turns the emergency flasher light ON manually.

question_en: After getting the DJ Locking sign, the Loco pilot should immediately:
question_hi: डीजे लॉक होने का चेकिंग साइन मिलने पर चालक को तुरंत क्या करना चाहिए:

options.A: Lower panto manually (ZPT to 0)
options.B: Apply SA-9
options.C: Take more notches
options.D: Reset MCB 112.1

explanation: If DJ locks closed during No-Tension, lower the pantograph immediately to isolate transformer primary from catenary surge.

question_en: HC-105 is to be put on '0' after ensuring:
question_hi: HC-105 को '0' पर रखने से पहले क्या सुनिश्चित करना चाहिए:

options.A: All pilot lamps glowing
options.B: DJ is closed
options.C: Contactor C-105 is open and compressor working
options.D: Pantograph raised

explanation: Ensure compressor 1 contactor C-105 is de-energised and opened before isolating HC-105 switch.

question_en: In conventional loco, auxiliary compressor unloader valve is energized through:
question_hi: कन्वेंशनल लोको में ऑक्जीलरी कम्प्रेशर अनलोडर वाल्व इनरजाइज होता है:

options.A: VCD
options.B: RGCP
options.C: RGLP
options.D: VEAD

explanation: VEAD magnet valve unloads auxiliary compressor during starting.

question_en: In STC Loco, if relay QSIT energises then on closing DJ, Loco pilot will experience:
question_hi: स्टैटिक कनवर्टर युक्त लोको में यदि रिले QSIT इनरजाइज हो तो डीजे क्लोज करने पर क्या होगा:

options.A: Tripping in Operation-O
options.B: Tripping in Operation-II
options.C: Tripping in Operation-I
options.D: No tripping

explanation: QSIT is the internal/external fault relay of SIV; its pick-up directly trips DJ in Operation-O.

question_en: In WAG-9 Loco, circuit breaker 110 and 112.1 are provided in:
question_hi: WAG-9 लोको में सर्किट ब्रेकर 110 तथा 112.1 कहाँ स्थित हैं:

options.A: Machine Room Wall
options.B: SB-1 Panel
options.C: SB-2 Panel
options.D: HB-1 Panel

explanation: Circuit breakers 110 (battery charger input) and 112.1 (battery power to control electronics) are in SB-2.

question_en: The action of Constant Speed Control (CSC) is cancelled by:
question_hi: CSC (कांस्टेंट स्पीड कंट्रोल) की क्रियाशीलता किसके द्वारा निरस्त होती है:

options.A: Applying parking brake only
options.B: Both moving throttle and pressing BPCS button
options.C: Pressing BPCS button
options.D: Moving throttle

explanation: CSC automatically drops out when the driver moves the TE/BE throttle or presses the BPCS push button.

question_en: The normal height of contact wire from rail level on tangent track is:
question_hi: रेल हेड से कांटेक्ट वायर की सामान्य ऊंचाई कितनी होती है:
explanation: Standard regulated contact wire height above rail head is 5.55 m (5.60 m in certain heavy freight sections).

question_en: A short circuit in an electric circuit causes abnormal:
question_hi: शॉर्ट सर्किट के कारण परिपथ में क्या होता है:

options.A: Over current
options.B: Over voltage
options.C: Drop in frequency
options.D: No effect

explanation: A low resistance short circuit causes an extreme surge of electric current (over-current).

question_en: Tap changer transformer (TFP / TAPR) in conventional locos is:
question_hi: कन्वेंशनल लोको में TFP / TAPR ट्रांसफार्मर होता है:

options.A: Step-down Auto Transformer with taps
options.B: Current transformer
options.C: Constant voltage transformer
options.D: Step-up transformer

explanation: The primary winding and tapped regulation winding act as an autotransformer feeding the stepped-down secondary traction circuits.

question_en: In 3-phase locos, parking brakes are applied automatically by putting:
question_hi: 3-फेज लोको में पार्किंग ब्रेक स्वतः लग जाते हैं जब:

options.A: Reverser to 0
options.B: BL key from 'D' to 'OFF'
options.C: ZPT on 0
options.D: A-9 to emergency

explanation: Turning the BL key switch from driving mode 'D' to 'OFF' vents parking brake air cylinders and applies spring brakes.

question_en: For glowing Marker Red light we should operate switch:
question_hi: मार्कर रेड लाइट जलाने के लिए कौन सा स्विच ऑपरेट करते हैं:

options.A: BLPRD
options.B: BLPRR
options.C: ZLS
options.D: BLZLF

explanation: BLPRR operates the red marker light switch on the driver desk.

question_en: The optimum oil level in the sight glass of GR should be maintained within:
question_hi: जीआर के ऑयल लेवल गेज में तेल का स्तर सामान्यतः होना चाहिए:

options.A: At top glass rim
options.B: Completely filled
options.C: ±15°C to ±20°C marks
options.D: Below 0°C line

explanation: GR transformer oil level is verified against temperature graduation marks (±15°C to ±20°C).

question_en: Relay Q-20 checks and protects against:
question_hi: रिले Q-20 किसके विरुद्ध सुरक्षा प्रदान करता है:

options.A: Over voltage in traction motors
options.B: Differential current
options.C: Earth fault in auxiliary
options.D: Over current in TM

explanation: Q-20 is an overvoltage protection relay set to pick up when traction motor voltage exceeds 865 V.

question_en: Permissible BP leakage allowed in standalone Locomotive during test:
question_hi: लोकोमोटिव में BP प्रेशर लीकेज की अनुमेय सीमा क्या है:

options.A: 1.25 kg/cm² in 5 min
options.B: 1.0 kg/cm² in 1 min
options.C: 0.7 kg/cm² in 5 min
options.D: 0.2 kg/cm² in 5 min

explanation: Standard standalone locomotive BP leakage benchmark is not more than 0.7 kg/cm² within 5 minutes.

question_en: If GR returns to '0' with LSB glowing, it is due to:
question_hi: यदि LSB जलने के साथ जीआर शून्य पर वापस आ जाए, तो इसका कारण है:

options.A: QRS action
options.B: Q-20 pick-up
options.C: Q-50 de-energisation
options.D: QD pick-up

explanation: When relay Q-50 de-energises while notches are active, auto-regression occurs and LSB glows.

question_en: Continuous current rating of WAG-7 Loco is:
question_hi: WAG-7 लोको की निरंतर करंट रेटिंग कितनी होती है:
explanation: WAG-7 continuous traction motor current rating is 900 A (its 10-minute short-time rating is 1250 A).

question_en: On WAG-5 Loco No-23401, QD-2 is connected between:
question_hi: WAG-5 लोको में QD-2 किन मोटर्स के बीच जुड़ी होती है:

options.A: TM-2 and TM-3
options.B: TM-3 and TM-4
options.C: TM-4 and TM-5
options.D: TM-1 and TM-2

explanation: QD-1 balances Bogie 1 motors (TM 2 & 3), and QD-2 balances Bogie 2 motors (TM 4 & 5).

question_en: Contactor C-145 is an:
question_hi: कॉन्टैक्टर C-145 किस प्रकार का कॉन्टैक्टर है:

options.A: Cam contactor
options.B: Vacuum switch
options.C: Electro-pneumatic contactor
options.D: Electromagnetic contactor

explanation: C-145 is an electro-pneumatically actuated contactor that establishes dynamic braking resistance circuits.

question_en: In Locomotive ARNO is a:
question_hi: लोको में ARNO क्या होता है:

options.A: DC generator
options.B: Phase converter (1-phase to 3-phase)
options.C: Static inverter
options.D: Air compressor

explanation: ARNO is a rotary phase converter converting 380V single-phase AC into 3-phase AC.

question_en: Voltmeter is always connected with source of supply in:
question_hi: वोल्टमीटर को हमेशा सप्लाई स्रोत के साथ किस क्रम में जोड़ा जाता है:

options.A: Series-Parallel
options.B: Bridge arrangement
options.C: Parallel
options.D: Series

explanation: Voltmeters have high internal resistance and must always be connected in parallel across the measured points.

question_en: Maximum staggering of contact wire on tangent (straight) track may be:
question_hi: सीधे ट्रैक पर संपर्क तार का अधिकतम स्टेगर कितना हो सकता है:
explanation: On tangent track, contact wire is staggered ±200 mm from track center to ensure uniform pantograph strip wear.

question_en: Switch provided to start the blowers to cool the Traction motor in WAG-9 Loco:
question_hi: WAG-9 लोको में ट्रैक्शन मोटर ब्लोअर चालू करने वाला स्विच:

options.A: None (Controlled by BUR)
options.B: BLVMT
options.C: ZBAN
options.D: Switch 154

explanation: In 3-phase locomotives, blowers are automatically sequenced and powered via BUR auxiliary converters.

question_en: If HMCS-2 is put on '2' then it isolates:
question_hi: यदि HMCS-2 को '2' पर रखा जाए तो कौन सा ट्रैक्शन मोटर अलग होगा:

options.A: TM-5
options.B: TM-4
options.C: TM-6
options.D: All Bogie-2 motors

explanation: HMCS-2 isolates TM-4 on pos 1, TM-5 on pos 2, and TM-6 on pos 3.

question_en: The 'W' shape structure in the middle axle of a bogie in a WAG-7 Loco is called:
question_hi: WAG-7 लोको बोगी के मध्य एक्सल पर 'W' आकार की संरचना कहलाती है:

options.A: Equalising beam
options.B: Torque arm
options.C: J-Bracket
options.D: Compensating beam

explanation: The compensating beam balances load distribution across the 3 axles of the Co-Co trimount bogie.

question_en: Wedging of Q-118 is restricted in:
question_hi: Q-118 की वेजिंग वर्जित है:

options.A: All Locos
options.B: Leading Loco only
options.C: Banking Loco only
options.D: Trailing Loco only

explanation: Wedging Q-118 bypasses auxiliary safety protections; doing so is strictly forbidden on all locomotives.

question_en: Normal position of QVMT is:
question_hi: QVMT रिले की सामान्य स्थिति क्या होती है:

options.A: De-energised
options.B: Picked-up
options.C: Energised
options.D: Wedged

explanation: QVMT is an airflow vane relay; it remains de-energised until blowers run and create sufficient dynamic air draft.

question_en: Bonding in SL-2 will cause:
question_hi: SL-2 में अर्थ फॉल्ट होने पर कौन सी रिले ड्रॉप होगी:

options.A: Dropping of QOP-2
options.B: Dropping of QOA
options.C: Dropping of QOP-1
options.D: Dropping of QLM

explanation: SL-2 is part of Power Circuit 2; an earth fault triggers the earth fault relay of circuit 2 (QOP-2).

question_en: When A-9 is applied:
question_hi: जब A-9 लगाया जाता है तो ब्रेक लगता है:

options.A: Only Loco brakes apply
options.B: Parking brake applies
options.C: Only Train brakes apply
options.D: Both Loco and Train brakes apply

explanation: A-9 exhausts train brake pipe (BP), applying train brakes as well as proportional loco brakes via distributor valve.

question_en: Dropper is the part of:
question_hi: ड्रॉपर किसका भाग है:

options.A: Transformer
options.B: Pantograph
options.C: OHE
options.D: Motor

explanation: Droppers are flexible copper wires supporting the contact wire horizontally below the catenary wire.

question_en: TFP is a:
question_hi: TFP ट्रांसफार्मर होता है:

options.A: Auto Transformer
options.B: Step down Transformer
options.C: Inverter Transformer
options.D: Step up Transformer

explanation: It steps down 25 kV catenary supply to intermediate working voltages for traction converters/rectifiers.

question_en: If receivers are connected in parallel the voltage on each receiver is:
question_hi: यदि रिसीवर पैरेलल में जुड़े हों तो प्रत्येक पर वोल्टेज होता है:

options.A: Same
options.B: Zero
options.C: Higher than source
options.D: Divided equally

explanation: Parallel circuit branches share an identical potential difference (voltage) across their terminals.

question_en: To isolate traction Converter No. 1 or 2 switch 154 to be kept on:
question_hi: ट्रैक्शन कनवर्टर 1 या 2 को अलग करने के लिए स्विच 154 को रखा जाता है:

options.A: Position '0'
options.C: NORM
options.D: Position '1' or '2'

explanation: Switch 154 selects converter isolation: pos 1 isolates Converter-1, pos 2 isolates Converter-2.

question_en: If both panto not raising fuse to be checked:
question_hi: यदि दोनों पैंटो नहीं उठ रहे हों तो कौन सा फ्यूज जांचना चाहिए:

options.A: CCLS and CCLC
options.B: CCBA and CCPT
options.C: CCVT and CCAD
options.D: CCDJ and CCINV

explanation: CCBA (battery supply) and CCPT (pantograph control circuit fuse) are required for panto magnet valves.

question_en: In WAG-9 Loco parking brake cylinders are on wheel No:
question_hi: WAG-9 लोको में पार्किंग ब्रेक सिलेंडर किन चक्कों पर होते हैं:
explanation: Parking brake cylinders are installed on wheels 2, 6 (Bogie-1) and 7, 11 (Bogie-2) of Co-Co 3-phase locos.

question_en: Rating of CCLSA is:
question_hi: CCLSA फ्यूज की रेटिंग है:

options.A: 6 Amps
options.B: 10 Amps
options.C: 16 Amps
options.D: 35 Amps

explanation: CCLSA (pilot lamp and signal circuit protection) has a nominal standard rating of 6 Amps.

question_en: If BLRDJ is defective, then DJ can be closed by:
question_hi: यदि BLRDJ खराब हो जाए तो डीजे बंद किया जा सकता है:

options.A: Operating Q-50
options.B: Wedging Q-45
options.C: Manual operation of Q-44
options.D: Wedging Q-118

explanation: Q-44 can be manually held for 2–3 seconds while BLDJ is kept closed to complete the MTDJ holding circuit.

question_en: BP leakage allowed on train is:
question_hi: ट्रेन में BP लीकेज की अनुमेय सीमा है:

options.A: 0.25 kg/cm² in 1 min
options.B: Both 0.25 kg/cm² in 1 min & 1.25 kg/cm² in 5 min (Equivalent)
options.C: 1.25 kg/cm² in 5 min
options.D: 0.5 kg/cm² in 1 min

explanation: Train BP leakage test criterion is max 0.25 kg/cm² drop per minute (or 1.25 kg/cm² over 5 minutes).

question_en: In WAG-5 Loco to isolate TM-2, HMCS-1 is to be kept on:
question_hi: WAG-5 लोको में TM-2 को अलग करने के लिए HMCS-1 को किस स्थिति में रखा जाता है:

options.A: Position-1
options.B: Position-2
options.C: Position-3
options.D: Position-4

explanation: HMCS-1 controls Bogie-1 motors: Pos 1 isolates TM-1, Pos 2 isolates TM-2, Pos 3 isolates TM-3.

question_en: Time lag of Q-44 is:
question_hi: Q-44 रिले का टाइम लैग है:

options.A: 2.0 seconds
options.B: 5.0 seconds
options.C: 10.0 seconds
options.D: 0.6 second

explanation: Q-44 is equipped with a pneumatic/dashpot time-lag damper of 5 seconds.

question_en: QRS should be wedged always in:
question_hi: QRS को हमेशा किस स्थिति में वेज किया जाना चाहिए:

options.A: Energised condition
options.B: Either condition
options.C: De-energised condition
options.D: Wedging not permitted

explanation: In rare approved troubleshooting procedures, QRS is temporarily wedged in energised condition.

question_en: At level crossing minimum height of contact wire above rail level is:
question_hi: लेवल क्रॉसिंग पर संपर्क तार की न्यूनतम ऊंचाई होती है:
explanation: At road level crossings, contact wire height must not be less than 5.50 m to provide road vehicle clearance.

question_en: The accidental contact between two different levels in circuit is called:
question_hi: सर्किट में दो अलग-अलग विभव स्तरों के बीच आकस्मिक संपर्क कहलाता है:

options.A: Overload
options.B: Short circuit
options.C: Open circuit
options.D: Earthing

explanation: An unintended contact between conductors of different potentials creates a short circuit.

question_en: OHE with provision of auto tensioning device and an anchor at other end is called:
question_hi: एक सिरे पर ATD और दूसरे सिरे पर एंकर वाली OHE कहलाती है:

options.A: Unregulated OHE
options.B: Regulated OHE
options.C: Tramway OHE
options.D: Semi-regulated OHE

explanation: Semi-regulated OHE uses an ATD at one end of the tension length and a fixed termination at the other.

question_en: The main grounding switch of the Locomotive is:
question_hi: लोकोमोटिव का मुख्य ग्राउंडिंग स्विच है:

options.A: HOM
options.B: HQOP
options.C: HOBA
options.D: HBA

explanation: HOM connects the high-voltage roof and transformer leads directly to loco earth.

question_en: If CPA is not working, Loco pilot should check the fuse:
question_hi: यदि CPA काम नहीं कर रहा है तो लोको पायलट को कौन सा फ्यूज जांचना चाहिए:

options.A: CCPT
options.B: CCLS
options.C: CCPA
options.D: CCBA

explanation: CCPA is the dedicated DC auxiliary compressor motor fuse.

question_en: If there is a bonding in SL-1 then relay will drop:
question_hi: यदि SL-1 में बॉन्डिंग/अर्थ फॉल्ट हो तो कौन सी रिले ड्रॉप होगी:

options.A: QLM
options.B: QOA
options.C: QOP-2
options.D: QOP-1

explanation: SL-1 is in power circuit 1, so QOP-1 drops upon detecting an earth fault.

question_en: In WAG-7 Loco QSD pick up is at:
question_hi: WAG-7 लोको में QSD का पिकअप होता है:

options.A: 160 Amps
options.B: 100 Amps
options.C: 250 Amps
options.D: 500 Amps

explanation: QSD / QD picks up when current differential between coupled motors reaches 160 Amps.

question_en: SIV fails to start without any indication, fuse to be checked:
question_hi: बिना किसी संकेत के SIV शुरू न होने पर कौन सा फ्यूज जांचें:

options.A: CCPT
options.B: CCINV
options.C: CCLS
options.D: CCRA

explanation: CCINV provides control power supply to the static converter gate control electronic rack.

question_en: Block/Bogie can be isolated by putting switch on '0':
question_hi: ब्लॉक को किस स्विच को '0' पर रखकर अलग किया जा सकता है:

options.A: HMCS-1 / HMCS-2
options.B: HVMT
options.C: HQOP
options.D: HPH

explanation: HMCS-1/2 isolates traction motor power blocks/bogies.

question_en: In WAG-7 Loco, VCD can be isolated by:
question_hi: WAG-7 लोको में VCD को अलग किया जा सकता है:

options.A: Switch 154
options.B: Switch 152
options.C: Switch HVCD on '0'
options.D: Switch BPSW

explanation: HVCD rotary switch is put on position '0' (off) along with isolating the VCD pneumatic cut-out cock.

question_en: ATD is used to provide:
question_hi: ATD का उपयोग क्या प्रदान करने के लिए किया जाता है:

options.A: Constant voltage
options.B: Speed control
options.C: Constant tension to catenary & contact wire
options.D: Current limiting

explanation: ATD counterweights automatically compensate for thermal expansion to keep conductor tension constant.

question_en: ARNO is used to convert single phase AC to:
question_hi: ARNO सिंगल फेज AC को किसमें परिवर्तित करता है:

options.A: Pulsating DC
options.B: DC supply
options.C: 3-phase AC (380V)
options.D: Higher frequency AC

explanation: ARNO converts 1-phase AC to 3-phase AC at 380V to run auxiliary motors.

question_en: A single phase induction motor needs starting mechanism because:
question_hi: सिंगल फेज इंडक्शन मोटर को स्टार्टिंग के दौरान किसकी आवश्यकता होती है:

options.A: DC excitation
options.B: Higher voltage
options.C: Speed governor
options.D: Starting winding / capacitor

explanation: Single phase motors have zero starting torque without an auxiliary starting winding or phase splitting.

question_en: MVSL-2 can be isolated in WAG-5 Loco by putting:
question_hi: WAG-5 लोको में MVSL-2 को अलग किया जा सकता है:

options.A: HMVSL-1 on '0'
options.B: HMVSL-2 on '0'
options.C: HQOP on '0'
options.D: HVMT on '0'

explanation: HMVSL-2 isolating switch placed on '0' disconnects the second smoothing reactor blower.

question_en: In 3-phase Loco MCB of CP-1 is provided in:
question_hi: 3-फेज लोको में CP-1 का MCB किसमें दिया गया है:

options.A: HB-2 Panel
options.B: HB-1 Panel
options.C: SB-1 Panel
options.D: SB-2 Panel

explanation: MCB 47.1/1 for Main Compressor 1 is provided in HB-1 cubicle.

question_en: Electromagnetic contactor should not be wedged in:
question_hi: इलेक्ट्रोमैग्नेटिक कॉन्टैक्टर को किस स्थिति में वेज नहीं करना चाहिए:

options.A: Either condition
options.B: Energised condition (Closed)
options.C: Open condition
options.D: De-energised condition

explanation: C-118 connects auxiliary starting resistance; wedging it closed causes burnout of starting resistors and DJ tripping.

question_en: During RB operation more than 1 kg/cm² pressure enters brake cylinder then RB will cut through:
question_hi: आरबी के दौरान 1 kg/cm² से अधिक दबाव ब्रेक सिलेंडर में जाने पर RB कटता है:

options.A: RGLP
options.B: SWC / PVEF
options.D: RGCP

explanation: SWC acts when SA-9 independent brake is applied and BC pressure rises above 1 kg/cm² to prevent wheel skidding.

question_en: On DC-DC Converter Loco if head light is not glowing check:
question_hi: DC-DC कनवर्टर लोको में यदि हेडलाइट नहीं जल रही है तो जांचें:

options.A: CCBA
options.B: MCB / Inverter fuse CC-DC
options.C: CCPT
options.D: CCLS

explanation: Check DC-DC converter output breaker/fuse feeding twin-beam headlight.

question_en: PT-2 can be isolated in WAG-9 Loco by putting switch in:
question_hi: WAG-9 लोको में PT-2 (Pantograph-2) को अलग किया जा सकता है स्विच को किस स्थिति में रखकर:

options.A: Switch 152 on '2'
options.B: Switch 154 on '0'
options.C: Switch BLDJ on '0'
options.D: ZPT / Switch 85 on position '1'

explanation: Panto selector switch 85 / ZPT placed on pos 1 isolates Pantograph 2.

question_en: DBR will cut off by the action of switch/relay if SA-9 is applied:
question_hi: SA-9 लगाने पर DBR किसकी क्रिया द्वारा कट जाएगा:

options.A: SWC / PVEF

explanation: SWC pressure switch detects independent brake cylinder air and interrupts dynamic braking.

question_en: If BLRDJ becomes defective DJ can be closed by:
question_hi: यदि BLRDJ खराब हो जाए तो डीजे बंद किया जा सकता है:

options.A: Manual operation of Q-44
options.B: Wedging Q-118
options.C: Wedging Q-45
options.D: Operating Q-50

explanation: Q-44 can be manually operated to close DJ.

question_en: Armature and field coil are the parts of:
question_hi: आर्मेचर और फील्ड कॉइल किसके भाग हैं:

options.A: DC Traction Motor
options.B: Alternator
options.C: 3-phase Induction Motor
options.D: Transformer

explanation: Armature and field windings are basic elements of DC commutator traction motors.

question_en: Accidental contact between electrical circuit to the Loco body is called:
question_hi: इलेक्ट्रिकल सर्किट और लोको बॉडी के बीच आकस्मिक संपर्क कहलाता है:

options.A: Short circuit
options.B: Earth fault
options.C: Open circuit
options.D: Overload

explanation: An unintended conduction path to the locomotive structure/ground is an earth fault.

question_en: In WAG-9 Loco emergency stop push button is provided on:
question_hi: WAG-9 लोको में इमरजेंसी स्टॉप पुश बटन दिया गया है:

options.A: Desk Panel-A
options.B: Panel-B
options.C: SB-1 Panel
options.D: Pneumatic Panel

explanation: Emergency stop push button (BPEMS) is located on Desk Panel A of both cabs.

question_en: To isolate VCD, the Loco pilot should:
question_hi: VCD को अलग करने के लिए लोको पायलट को क्या करना चाहिए:

options.A: Turn HVCD to '0' and close isolating cock
options.B: Apply A-9 emergency
options.C: Trip MCB 47.1
options.D: Switch off MCB 112.1

explanation: Isolate VCD cock on pneumatic panel and put HVCD switch on '0'.

question_en: Completion of preparation of RB is indicated through:
question_hi: RB तैयारी पूरी होने का संकेत मिलता है:

options.A: Lamp LSC-145 extinguishing
options.B: Lamp LSC-145 glowing
options.C: Lamp LSFI flashing
options.D: Lamp LSB glowing

explanation: LSC-145 pilot lamp extinguishing confirms that braking contactor C-145 has closed and braking setup is established.

question_en: The relay which can be wedged in both energized and de-energized condition:
question_hi: किस रिले को एनर्जाइज और डी-एनर्जाइज दोनों स्थितियों में वेज किया जा सकता है:

options.A: Relay Q-118
options.B: Relay QLM
options.C: Relay Q-49
options.D: Relay Q-44

explanation: Signaling/interlocking relay Q-49 can be set either way according to testing requirements.

question_en: Fuse for converter control circuit is:
question_hi: कनवर्टर कंट्रोल सर्किट का फ्यूज है:

options.A: CCRA
options.B: CCLS
options.C: CCINV
options.D: CCPT

explanation: CCINV protects the static converter electronic control rack.

question_en: When MP is brought to 'P' contactor gets closed in SIV Loco:
question_hi: SIV लोको में MP को 'P' पर लाने पर कौन सा कॉन्टैक्टर क्लोज होता है:
explanation: Contactor C-108 closes to feed MVRF when dynamic braking is initiated.

question_en: COC-74 is located in:
question_hi: COC-74 कहाँ स्थित है:

options.A: Machine room floor
options.B: Underframe
options.C: Pneumatic panel
options.D: Cab-1 desk

explanation: COC-74 (dead engine cock) is situated on the locomotive pneumatic panel.

question_en: MCB-100 provided at which panel in three phase loco:
question_hi: 3-फेज लोको में MCB-100 किस पैनल में दिया गया है:

options.A: SB-2 Panel
options.B: Pneumatic Panel
options.C: SB-1 Panel
options.D: HB-1 Panel

explanation: MCB-100 (battery main circuit breaker) is located in SB-1.

question_en: PT-2 can be isolated in WAG-9 Loco by putting switch in position:
question_hi: WAG-9 लोको में PT-2 को अलग किया जा सकता है स्विच को किस स्थिति में रखकर:

options.A: Position '0'
options.B: Position '2'
options.C: Position '1'
options.D: Position 'Auto'

explanation: Panto selector switch 85 / ZPT placed on pos 1 isolates Pantograph 2.

question_en: After experiencing tripping in Operation-O the Loco pilot should:
question_hi: ऑपरेशन-O में ट्रिपिंग के बाद लोको पायलट को क्या करना चाहिए:

options.A: Isolate bogie-1
options.B: Check TM current
options.C: Check brake cylinder pressure
options.D: Check control circuit fuses & DJ circuit

explanation: Operation-O denotes control circuit / holding failure; check CCBA, CCDJ, and control interlocks.

question_en: The GR oil level should be checked at temperature mark:
question_hi: जीआर ऑयल लेवल किस तापमान मार्क पर जाँचा जाना चाहिए:

options.D: ±15°C / Ambient

explanation: GR oil level should be between minimum and maximum marks at ambient temperature.

question_en: OHE with provision of auto tensioning device on both ends is called:
question_hi: दोनों सिरों पर ATD वाली OHE कहलाती है:

options.A: Fixed OHE
options.B: Semi-regulated OHE
options.C: Unregulated OHE
options.D: Regulated OHE

explanation: Regulated OHE has tensioning devices at both ends of the tension length.

question_en: Normal position of 16-38 key in Knorr pneumatic panel is:
question_hi: Knorr न्यूमैटिक पैनल में 16-38 की की सामान्य स्थिति है:

options.A: Test
options.B: Operative (Horizontal)
options.C: Isolated (Vertical)
options.D: Neutral

explanation: 16-38 key is kept in operative position for normal brake operation.

question_en: Number of three phase AC Auxiliaries in under-gearing of three phase Loco is:
question_hi: 3-फेज लोको के अंडर-गियरिंग में 3-फेज AC ऑक्जीलरी की संख्या है:

options.D: 0 (None)

explanation: No auxiliary machines are mounted in the under-gearing; all are in the machine room or underframe.

question_en: Type of traction motors used in WAP-7 Loco are:
question_hi: WAP-7 लोको में प्रयुक्त ट्रैक्शन मोटर का प्रकार है:

options.A: Single phase AC
options.B: 6 pole DC series
options.C: Parallel Induction
options.D: 3-phase Induction Motor

explanation: WAP-7 uses 3-phase squirrel cage induction traction motors (type 6FRA 6068).

question_en: The control circuit of DC is protected from overcurrent by:
question_hi: DC कंट्रोल सर्किट की सुरक्षा की जाती है:

options.A: Capacitor
options.B: Fuse & Relay
options.C: Inductor
options.D: Resistor

explanation: Control circuits are protected by circuit fuses (CCBA, CCDJ, etc.) and protective relays.

question_en: On Static converter Locos earth fault in auxiliary power circuit is detected by:
question_hi: स्टैटिक कनवर्टर लोको में ऑक्जीलरी पावर सर्किट में अर्थ फॉल्ट पहचाना जाता है:

options.A: The static converter itself (ELD)
options.B: QOA
options.C: QLM
options.D: QOP

explanation: SIV incorporates internal earth fault detection module replacing QOA.

question_en: On closing BLVMT the contactor which is closing last in a WAG-7 Loco is:
question_hi: BLVMT बंद करने पर WAG-7 लोको में सबसे अंत में क्लोज होने वाला कॉन्टैक्टर है:
explanation: Closing sequence is C-105, C-106, then C-107.

question_en: In MPCS Loco HPAR having positions:
question_hi: MPCS लोको में HPAR स्विच की पोजीशन होती हैं:

options.A: ON, OFF
options.B: A, B

explanation: HPAR has 2 positions: 0 (Normal) and 1 (Bypass Q-51).

question_en: In WAP-5 Loco parking brake release spindle cylinders are on wheels:
question_hi: WAP-5 लोको में पार्किंग ब्रेक रिलीज स्पिंडल सिलेंडर किन चक्कों पर होते हैं:
explanation: WAP-5 (Bo-Bo) has parking brakes on wheels 1, 4, 5, 8.

question_en: In Knorr WAG-9 Loco to reset VCD penalty brake we should wait for:
question_hi: Knorr WAG-9 लोको में VCD पेनल्टी ब्रेक रीसेट करने के लिए इंतजार करना चाहिए:

options.A: 120 sec
options.B: 60 sec
options.C: 160 sec
options.D: 32 sec

explanation: Enforced penalty time delay is 160 seconds.

question_en: In WAG-7 Loco to isolate TM-2 & 3 for any trouble:
question_hi: WAG-7 लोको में TM-2 एवं 3 को अलग करने के लिए:

options.A: Operate HMCS-1 (isolate Block-1)
options.B: Operate HMCS-2
options.C: Isolate Block-2
options.D: Wedge Q-50

explanation: Operate HMCS-1 to isolate TM 1, 2, 3 together.

question_en: The Location of OCR-78 is in:
question_hi: OCR-78 की लोकेशन है:

options.A: Pneumatic panel
options.B: SB-1 Panel
options.C: HB-1 Panel
options.D: SB-2 Panel

explanation: OCR-78 is located in switchgear cubicle SB-1.

question_en: In 3 phase Loco MCBs of AC Auxiliaries provided at:
question_hi: 3-फेज लोको में AC ऑक्जीलरी के MCB कहाँ दिए गए हैं:

options.A: Pneumatic panel
options.B: SB-1 & SB-2
options.C: HB-1 & HB-2 Panels
options.D: Cab-1

explanation: AC auxiliary machine MCBs are installed in HB-1 and HB-2 cubicles.

question_en: Contact wire is connected to steady arm by:
question_hi: संपर्क तार स्टडी आर्म से जुड़ा होता है:

options.A: Stay tube
options.B: Dropper
options.C: Bracket
options.D: Steady arm ear / clamp

explanation: The contact wire is held by a swivel ear/clamp attached to the steady arm.

question_en: By reverser the direction of flow of current changes in:
question_hi: रिवर्सर द्वारा करंट के प्रवाह की दिशा बदली जाती है:

options.A: Starting coil
options.B: Armature coil
options.C: Interpole
options.D: Field coil of DC Traction Motor

explanation: Current through the field windings is reversed to change rotational direction.

question_en: To make WAG-9 dead, which MCB to be switched off in SB-2 panel:
question_hi: WAG-9 को डेड बनाने के लिए SB-2 पैनल में कौन सा MCB बंद किया जाता है:

options.A: MCB 110
options.D: MCB 47.1

explanation: MCB 112.1 disconnects control electronics battery supply.

question_en: Shortest section of OHE which can be isolated by switching operation is called:
question_hi: स्विचिंग ऑपरेशन द्वारा अलग किया जाने वाला OHE का सबसे छोटा खंड है:

options.A: Sector
options.B: Elementary section
options.C: Feeding zone
options.D: Subsector

explanation: An elementary section is the smallest switchable segment.

question_en: Before resetting of any MCB, Loco Pilot must check:
question_hi: किसी भी MCB को रीसेट करने से पहले लोको पायलट को जांचना चाहिए:

options.A: Battery water
options.B: Brake cylinder pressure

options.D: Zero tolerance for air flow indicator movement

explanation: Pneumatic standards strictly define permissible leakage thresholds for standalone locomotive and train consist respectively.

options.B: Operating master controller with defective reverser drums
options.C: Regular inspection of oil level, contactor cleanliness, and fuse ratings
options.D: Running without checking air pressure gauges

explanation: Loco operating rules require regular inspection of vital oil levels, air gauges, and interlock contacts.

question_en: Safety circuit interlock condition during auxiliary operation mandates that:
question_hi: ऑक्जीलरी संचालन के दौरान सुरक्षा सर्किट इंटरलॉक शर्त अनिवार्य करती है कि:

options.A: DJ holding circuit must be bypassed with copper wire
options.B: Safety relays Q118, Q44, and C118 must never be wedged closed
options.C: All protective relays must be wedged continuously
options.D: Auxiliary blowers should be isolated at full speed

explanation: Safety relays protect auxiliary motors and transformers from thermal breakdown; wedging is prohibited under railway technical safety circulars.

question_en: Pneumatic brake testing and leakage assessment protocol specifies:
question_hi: न्यूमैटिक ब्रेक परीक्षण एवं लीकेज जांच प्रोटोकॉल निर्दिष्ट करता है:

options.A: Constant draining of main reservoir without governor cutout
options.B: Zero tolerance for air flow indicator movement
options.C: BP leakage within 0.7 kg/cm² in 5 min on standalone loco, 1.25 kg/cm² in 5 min on train
options.D: Direct emergency exhaust via unloader valve

explanation: Pneumatic standards strictly define permissible leakage thresholds for standalone locomotive and train consist respectively.

question_en: Overhead Equipment (OHE) regulations require contact wire height and staggering to be:
question_hi: ओवरहेड इक्विपमेंट (OHE) विनियमन के अनुसार संपर्क तार की ऊंचाई और स्टेगर होना चाहिए:

options.A: Unregulated tensioning with 1 metre deflection
options.B: Direct grounding across all neutral sections
options.C: Regulated height of 5.55 m and maximum staggering of ±200 mm on tangent track
options.D: Fixed height of 4.20 m with zero staggering

explanation: 5.55 m contact wire height and ±200 mm stagger ensure safe pantograph clearance and even contact strip carbon wear.

question_en: Static Converter (SIV) diagnostic protocol indicates that on detecting earth fault:

options.A: Battery charger instantly trips without indication
options.B: Pantograph automatically drops within 1 second
options.C: Internal earth leakage sensor triggers LSSIT and isolates auxiliary feed
options.D: Compressor starts in reverse rotation

explanation: SIV solid-state control rack senses ground leakage through ELD and protects auxiliary circuits by illuminating LSSIT and tripping SIV.

options.A: Running without checking air pressure gauges
options.B: Regular inspection of oil level, contactor cleanliness, and fuse ratings
options.C: Bypassing safety interlocks during normal line run
options.D: Operating master controller with defective reverser drums

explanation: Loco operating rules require regular inspection of vital oil levels, air gauges, and interlock contacts.

question_en: Safety circuit interlock condition during auxiliary operation mandates that:
question_hi: ऑक्जीलरी संचालन के दौरान सुरक्षा सर्किट इंटरलॉक शर्त अनिवार्य करती है कि:

options.A: All protective relays must be wedged continuously
options.B: Auxiliary blowers should be isolated at full speed
options.C: DJ holding circuit must be bypassed with copper wire
options.D: Safety relays Q118, Q44, and C118 must never be wedged closed

explanation: Safety relays protect auxiliary motors and transformers from thermal breakdown; wedging is prohibited under railway technical safety circulars.

question_en: Pneumatic brake testing and leakage assessment protocol specifies:
question_hi: न्यूमैटिक ब्रेक परीक्षण एवं लीकेज जांच प्रोटोकॉल निर्दिष्ट करता है:

options.A: BP leakage within 0.7 kg/cm² in 5 min on standalone loco, 1.25 kg/cm² in 5 min on train
options.B: Direct emergency exhaust via unloader valve
options.C: Constant draining of main reservoir without governor cutout
options.D: Zero tolerance for air flow indicator movement

explanation: Pneumatic standards strictly define permissible leakage thresholds for standalone locomotive and train consist respectively.

question_en: Overhead Equipment (OHE) regulations require contact wire height and staggering to be:
question_hi: ओवरहेड इक्विपमेंट (OHE) विनियमन के अनुसार संपर्क तार की ऊंचाई और स्टेगर होना चाहिए:

options.A: Regulated height of 5.55 m and maximum staggering of ±200 mm on tangent track
options.B: Fixed height of 4.20 m with zero staggering
options.C: Direct grounding across all neutral sections
options.D: Unregulated tensioning with 1 metre deflection

explanation: 5.55 m contact wire height and ±200 mm stagger ensure safe pantograph clearance and even contact strip carbon wear.

question_en: Static Converter (SIV) diagnostic protocol indicates that on detecting earth fault:
question_hi: स्टैटिक कनवर्टर (SIV) डायग्नोस्टिक प्रोटोकॉल इंगित करता है कि अर्थ फॉल्ट पाए जाने पर:

options.A: Battery charger instantly trips without indication
options.B: Compressor starts in reverse rotation
options.C: Internal earth leakage sensor triggers LSSIT and isolates auxiliary feed
options.D: Pantograph automatically drops within 1 second

explanation: SIV solid-state control rack senses ground leakage through ELD and protects auxiliary circuits by illuminating LSSIT and tripping SIV.

question_en: Overhead Equipment (OHE) regulations require contact wire height and staggering to be:

options.A: Direct grounding across all neutral sections

options.B: Compressor starts in reverse rotation
options.C: Pantograph automatically drops within 1 second
options.D: Internal earth leakage sensor triggers LSSIT and isolates auxiliary feed
